findings.message: The content stops 382px short of the right edge while it starts 44px from the sidebar.
findings.fix: Let the grid fill the canvas (columns in fr units), or centre a capped canvas with equal margins. A dead strip on one side reads as unfinished.
Data and labels read at 13–14px; keep 11–12px for sublines and axis ticks.

findings.message: Only 2 of 13 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.
